flashcards.q: How is keep used in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: AI Data Privacy and Governance teaches how to use AI with customer and company data safely and legally, and how to set the policies that keep a team's AI use trustworthy.

flashcards.q: How should approved not be handled in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: Write an AI use policy: approved tools, data that may never be entered, required human review for customer-facing output, and how to report a problem.

flashcards.q: What is data minimization?
flashcards.a: Data minimization is the principle of sending an AI system only the data a task needs.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with keep in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: AI Data Privacy and Governance teaches how to use AI with customer and company data safely and legally, and how to set the policies that keep a team's AI use trustworthy.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling call summary in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: A call summary does not need the customer's payment details.

flashcards.q: Why is collected not always the right choice in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: Data collected for one purpose, such as delivering a service, should not be reused for an unrelated purpose without a lawful basis.

flashcards.q: How is collected used in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: Privacy laws such as the GDPR in Europe and state laws such as the California Consumer Privacy Act limit how it may be collected, used and shared.

flashcards.q: What does AI Data Privacy And Governance teach about processor?
flashcards.a: When data is sent to an AI provider, the provider becomes a processor of that data.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with assistant in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: An assistant connected to the CRM should respect the same permissions as the user.

flashcards.q: Who should not be handling approved in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: Write an AI use policy: approved tools, data that may never be entered, required human review for customer-facing output, and how to report a problem.

flashcards.q: How is processor used in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: Enterprise buyers increasingly ask how vendors use AI; a clear policy, a processor list and an audit trail shorten security reviews.

flashcards.q: What does AI Data Privacy And Governance teach about provider?
flashcards.a: A data processing agreement sets out what the provider may do with it, where it is stored and how it is deleted.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with touches in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: Keep a register of AI systems in use, what data each touches, who owns it and when it was last reviewed.

flashcards.q: What does AI Data Privacy And Governance teach about redaction?
flashcards.a: Redaction removes or masks sensitive fields before text is sent to a model.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with emails in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: Log AI-assisted actions that affect customers, such as emails sent or records changed, so any error can be traced and corrected.

flashcards.q: What does AI Data Privacy And Governance teach about redaction?
flashcards.a: Automated redaction of emails, phone numbers and account numbers is a common safeguard.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with processor in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: Enterprise buyers increasingly ask how vendors use AI; a clear policy, a processor list and an audit trail shorten security reviews.

flashcards.q: What is assuming the vendor handles compliance?
flashcards.a: Assuming the vendor handles compliance is a mistake.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with contracts in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: Pasting customer lists or contracts into consumer AI tools can breach contracts and privacy law.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with touches in AI Data Privacy And Governance?
flashcards.a: Draft a one-page AI use policy for your team, list every AI tool currently in use with the data it touches, and identify the single highest-risk use that needs a safeguard this month.
